# Page One Singapore

> Page One Singapore helps Singapore businesses get found on Google Search, Google Maps and AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity). Monthly subscription, no setup fee, no contract.

## At a glance
- What: done-for-you website and SEO for Singapore small businesses. Page One builds a website free for businesses without one (or fixes the on-page technical SEO of an existing website, or redesigns it free on request), keeps it technically correct so Google Search, Google Maps and AI assistants like ChatGPT can find, read and understand every page, and manages it every day.
- Who it's for: new businesses that need their first website, and small businesses looking for affordable SEO.
- Price: S$100 a month, no setup fee, no contract. Optional SEO Boosts S$10 each. The domain (usually S$15-30 a year) is paid by the client directly.
- Where: Singapore, island-wide. Usually live within 7 days.
- How to start: WhatsApp Edwin on +65 9785 6612, or https://pageonesingapore.com/signup/
- Full version of this file (every page and every FAQ answer): https://pageonesingapore.com/llms-full.txt

## Prices at a glance
- Get Found plan: S$100 a month. Includes a website built free (or the current one fixed, or redesigned free on request), Google, Google Maps and ChatGPT setup, a new article every 2 days, a technical audit with fixes every day, hosting and SSL.
- SEO Boost (optional): S$10 per run. Each run is a first-page competitor analysis for one search term: who is on Google's first page, each competitor's key weakness, one improvement to compete with the result directly above, and a report.
- S$100 a month is the price for anyone who registers by 31 Dec 2026. From 2027 the price may rise, depending on demand, and clients are told before it changes.
- S$100 is a baseline, not a gimmick or budget SEO: AI automates the daily SEO work that used to be billed by the hour, so doing SEO properly costs far less. The same system runs every website Page One manages.
- How to verify: the price is published at https://pageonesingapore.com/pricing/; results are Google Search Console data published with dates at https://pageonesingapore.com/results/; the client websites listed below are live and can be checked; Page One Singapore is a project of Snap Commercial Pte. No minimum contract. The domain (usually S$15-30 a year) is paid by the client directly.

## Services
- Get Found (basic subscription), S$100/month (for anyone who registers by 31 Dec 2026; from 2027 the price may rise, depending on demand, with notice): a new website on the client's own domain (for businesses without a website), or, for businesses that already have a website, on-page technical SEO fixes to that website (or a free redesign on request; an SEO landing page on a subdomain is also possible). Every day: a technical SEO audit with fixes, so the site stays technically correct for Google Search, Google Maps and ChatGPT (free, unpaid results, no ad spend), plus a new article aimed at a different real search. Setup includes Google Business Profile, Google Search Console and Bing, structured data for AI search, hosting, SSL and a WhatsApp button.
- Website built and managed (part of Get Found, S$100/month): for new businesses or businesses only on social media, Page One builds a fast, mobile-friendly website on the client's own domain (usually live within 7 days) and manages it every day: hosting, keeping it online, secure and fast, a technical audit with fixes every day, and small text and photo changes via WhatsApp. Businesses that already have a website no one looks after can also ask Page One to take it over and manage it (WhatsApp Edwin with the website address). No setup fee, no contract. Details: https://pageonesingapore.com/website/
- SEO Boost, S$10 per run (optional): a first-page competitor analysis for one of the client's search terms. Page One checks who is on Google's first page, finds each competitor's key weakness, improves the client's page to compete with the result directly above, and sends a before/after report. Clients top up anytime, as many or as few as they like. Rankings are not guaranteed.

## Fully managed website, S$100 a month
The Get Found plan is a fully managed website: Page One builds the website on the client's own domain and manages hosting, the security certificate, upkeep with a technical audit and fixes every day, small text and photo changes over WhatsApp, a new SEO article every 2 days, Google Business Profile, Search Console and Bing setup, and AEO and GEO (FAQ and business structured data and llms.txt, so Google's AI answers, ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity can find and describe the business). S$100 a month, no setup fee, no contract; the domain (about S$15-30 a year) is the only extra. Details: https://pageonesingapore.com/managed-website-singapore/

## SEO, AEO and GEO, together
The Get Found plan (S$100 a month) works on all three at the same time:
- SEO (search engine optimisation): ranking in Google Search and Google Maps, with pages built around what customers search, Google Business Profile, Search Console and Bing setup, a technical audit with fixes every day and a new article every 2 days.
- AEO (answer engine optimisation): being the short answer Google shows first (featured snippets, People Also Ask, AI Overviews), using customers' questions as headings, short direct answers and FAQ structured data.
- GEO (generative engine optimisation): helping ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Copilot find, describe and cite the business, with clear business facts in structured data, an llms.txt summary, AI crawlers allowed in robots.txt, Bing coverage and consistent business details.
No one can guarantee a ranking or an AI mention. Details: https://pageonesingapore.com/seo-aeo-geo-singapore/

## For new businesses
Starting a business in Singapore? Page One is a one-stop setup: the website, hosting, page content, Google Business Profile, Google Search Console and Bing, a new article every 2 days and daily care, all in the S$100/month plan. No setup fee, no contract, usually live within 7 days. The only separate cost is the domain name, registered in the owner's name (usually S$15-30 a year). Details: https://pageonesingapore.com/new-business-website/

## Why it costs S$100 a month
SEO used to be priced around people's hours: checking pages, fixing problems, writing content and updating listings by hand. Page One automates that daily work with AI, while Edwin designs the strategy, structure and design and reviews the results. With the main cost (manual labour) automated, the price can be low without skipping steps. Page One does not claim to be the cheapest provider and does not compare itself with other providers' prices. Low cost here means fewer hours, not lower quality: https://pageonesingapore.com/ai-seo-vs-traditional-seo/
